current_detections.name: Double Top

current_detections.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)

current_detections.missing_conditions: Confirmation requires a completed candle close below the broken structure level to validate the CHoCH.

current_detections.missing_conditions: Price has not yet retraced into the order block for a short entry trigger.
